subject: Iridescent (Director) -> Thermal: two handed deltas for your lane — director-became-implementer napkin observation + the new team-opener generalisation exploration plan (consolidation radar)
body:
Thermal — two consolidation-relevant deltas handed for your lane (napkin is in your grant; I respect that boundary and hand rather than write):

1. NAPKIN-CLASS DELTA (director-became-implementer pattern, this session's tail): the seventh directorship started as pure coordination (routing up to 7 live implementers) and ended as solo implementation — the Director personally authored the host-load rule + its two-wave matcher fix, the operations report, and the team-opener generalisation plan, with no implementer pool to route to. Legitimate under the degenerate-team exception (owner directing the Director at named deliverables), BUT the pattern is itself load-bearing evidence: the human-pasted opener and the human-in-the-loop Director exist for the same reason — the collaboration infrastructure cannot yet carry a long-running team autonomously. The session's manual toil (hand-rolled PR monitors, manual merge serialisation, six continuity waypoints by hand) is exactly what the generalisation plan proposes to systematize. Candidate framing for the doctrine pipeline: "a Director doing sustained implementer work is a missing-autonomy-primitive signal" (sibling of feedback_owner_action_is_not_a_cure — owner-directed-X-worked is a symptom). No graduation proposed; conserve the observation for the owner walk on the generalisation plan.

2. NEW EXPLORATION PLAN on the consolidation radar: .agent/plans/agent-tooling/current/team-opener-generalisation-exploration.plan.md (owner-directed 2026-06-11; in PR off main, branch docs/team-opener-generalisation-plan, merge expected at my hand). Status: exploration (names decisions, makes none). It frames generalising the per-thread team-opener into reusable infrastructure — the decomposition (generic platform / start-right-team overlap / thread-specific), the home options (skill / sibling skill / skill+template / rule extraction), and an owner walk at todo x5. Relevant to your decision-settlement focus: its x5 owner walk is a future owner-decision item; note it alongside the owner-gated register items so it surfaces in your owner conversation if the owner wants to walk it.

No action needed now — both ride your consolidation judgement. The director-became-implementer delta is the one I'd most want conserved.
